headline: S&P 500 fell a fifth straight day (-0.23% to 7,323.63) and the Dow lost 1.11%, but Nasdaq rose 0.42%; futures jump about 1-2% on Nov 19 on Palo Alto, Nvidia and the Anthropic IPO while Fed minutes point to more hikes.
regime: Hiking regime: the Fed funds target is 3.75-4.00% and the Oct 27-28 minutes say almost all officials see more hikes; a 25bp December hike is about 95% priced (5% for 50bp). The 10-year is 5.07% and the VIX 24.56.

news.head: Fed minutes: nearly all officials see more rate hikes; Waller floats a half-point in December
news.srcN: Motley Fool, Nov 18; Stock Titan, Nov 18; QUE.com, Nov 18
news.mean: Minutes of the Oct 27-28 meeting (released Nov 18) said almost all officials judged further hikes likely appropriate with the funds rate at 3.75-4.00%. Waller told CNBC a half-point hike was probably needed Dec 8-9. CME FedWatch showed about 95% for 25bp and about 5% for 50bp.
news.hist: Rule of thumb: when a hike is already priced, minutes and pace guidance matter more than the decision itself.
news.today: Watch Vice Chair Jefferson (speaks Nov 19) for more on 25bp versus 50bp.
news.later: Investors may plan for higher-for-longer rates; the Dec 8-9 FOMC is the next test.

news.head: Mixed close: S&P 500 posts a fifth straight loss while Nasdaq rises; futures jump Nov 19
news.mean: Nov 18: Dow 50,198.17 (-1.11%), S&P 500 7,323.63 (-0.23%, fifth straight decline, longest since June), Nasdaq Composite 24,429.89 (+0.42%), Russell 2000 +0.46%. Premarket Nov 19 futures: Dow +0.61%, S&P +1.15%, Nasdaq-100 +2.06%. Energy (-3.51%) and health care (-2.18%) were the worst sectors.
news.hist: Rule of thumb: when a hike is mostly priced, the guidance on pace moves markets more than the decision.
news.today: Watch whether the premarket futures jump holds into the open after five S&P losses.
news.later: Investors may note the 10-year near 5.1% and a hawkish Fed still cap valuations.

news.head: Palo Alto Networks jumps about 10% on a revenue beat and raised guidance
news.mean: Revenue rose 39% to $3.44B (estimate $3.31B), next-gen security ARR rose 66% to $9.73B and the FY27 revenue guide went to $14.52-14.57B. The stock was up about 9-10% premarket; cybersecurity peers also rose on Nov 18 after a CISA warning.
react: Rallied Nov 18 on a CISA warning
news.hist: Rule of thumb: when a hike is mostly priced, the guidance on pace moves markets more than the decision.
news.today: Watch whether the gap holds; a roughly 10% gap often sees volatile trading.
news.later: Investors may weigh the all-stock acquisition reported by CappNotes against the growth.

news.head: Target, TJX and Lowe's beat; TJX jumps 8% but tariff refunds flatter EPS
news.srcN: Yahoo Finance, Nov 18; Stock Titan, Nov 18
news.mean: Target Q3 sales +7.1% to $27.1B and EPS $2.65 including about $0.50 of tariff refunds (stock +4.01%); TJX EPS $1.39 ($1.34 ex-refunds), comps +4%, stock +8.05%; Lowe's EPS $2.98 including $0.34 of refunds (+1.05%) with disappointing guidance per Xinhua. Consumer discretionary rose 2.24%.
news.hist: Rule of thumb: when a hike is mostly priced, the guidance on pace moves markets more than the decision.
news.today: Watch Walmart (before the open Nov 19) for the next read on the consumer.
news.later: Investors may separate one-time tariff refunds from the underlying trend.

news.head: Health insurers plunge on a CMS Medicare Advantage audit proposal
news.mean: UnitedHealth fell 10.21%, Humana 12.98%, Elevance 7.63%, Centene 7.03% and CVS 5.20% on Nov 18 after a CMS proposal to widen audit extrapolation (estimated $90.2B recovered over 2027-2036). Comments are open to Jan 19, 2027.
news.hist: Rule of thumb: when a hike is mostly priced, the guidance on pace moves markets more than the decision.
news.today: Watch for a bounce or further selling in a sector down sharply in two days.
news.later: Investors may wait for the final rule, which is months away.

news.head: Nvidia's post-earnings rally fizzles; Huang resigned as CEO on Nov 12
news.mean: After the Nov 17 beat (revenue $115.8B, Q4 guide about $130B), Nvidia fell 2.89% to $150.96 on Nov 18. Stock Titan says CEO Jensen Huang resigned Nov 12 with CFO Kress as interim CEO. Premarket Nov 19 it was up about 2% after Trump said Blackwell chips could reach China in 2-3 years.
news.hist: Rule of thumb: when a hike is mostly priced, the guidance on pace moves markets more than the decision.
news.today: Watch whether Nvidia holds its premarket gain.
news.later: Investors may weigh leadership change against the ~$130B guide.

news.head: Anthropic IPO priced at $83 and debuts on Nasdaq (ANT) on Nov 19
news.srcN: CappNotes, Nov 18; Rock & Turner, Nov 18; Gotrade, Nov 18
news.mean: Priced above the $70-78 range at $83; reports of the amount raised differ (about $68.5B vs $81.3B). Alphabet (+4.1%) and Amazon (+2.6%) were up premarket and Amazon rose 3.82% on Nov 18 on its stake. First-day trading was not verified.
news.hist: Rule of thumb: when a hike is mostly priced, the guidance on pace moves markets more than the decision.
news.today: First-day IPO trading is volatile and the open may swing.
news.later: Investors may note a mega-IPO can absorb capital from other AI names.

news.head: Gold and oil slide: gold -3.16% near a one-year low, WTI -3.2%
news.srcN: QUE.com, Nov 18; Stock Titan, Nov 18; Xinhua, Nov 19
news.mean: December gold settled at $3,741.90 (-3.16%); Stock Titan says spot gold fell 2.38% to its lowest in over a year, tied to hike expectations. WTI settled at $83.26 (-3.20%) after a bigger-than-expected US crude stock build (Stock Titan cites $82.19 intraday, Brent $91.95). Premarket Nov 19: WTI $83.79, Brent $92.51.
news.hist: Rule of thumb: when a hike is mostly priced, the guidance on pace moves markets more than the decision.
news.today: Watch whether oil and gold stabilize premarket.
news.later: Investors may see lower oil easing headline inflation if it persists.

news.mean: The 10-year yield was 5.07% (-3bp), the 20-year 5.44% and the 30-year 5.41%. The VIX closed at 24.56 (-3.53%) and Bitcoin at $62,227 (-2.58%).
news.hist: Rule of thumb: when a hike is mostly priced, the guidance on pace moves markets more than the decision.

news.head: Mortgage rate 7.11%; housing starts jump 9.9% to 1.31M but permits fall
news.mean: Freddie Mac's 30-year fixed rate was 7.11% as of Nov 12 (7.18% a week earlier); the Nov 19 release was not found. October starts rose 9.9% to 1.31M, permits fell 7.4% to 1.295M and pending home sales fell 4.7%.
news.hist: Rule of thumb: when a hike is mostly priced, the guidance on pace moves markets more than the decision.
news.today: Check the Thursday Freddie Mac release.
news.later: Investors may watch permits as the leading signal.

news.head: Inflation and jobs data keep the Fed hawkish
news.mean: October CPI rose 0.4% (estimate 0.3%) with core +0.3% (estimate 0.2%); October payrolls rose 165,000 and unemployment was 4.1%. PCE is due Nov 25.
news.hist: Rule of thumb: when a hike is mostly priced, the guidance on pace moves markets more than the decision.
news.later: Investors may expect the Fed to stay hawkish until inflation cools.

playbook: Homebuilders, REITs, utilities, small caps and unprofitable growth are pressured first. Banks and the dollar hold up better.
Housing, small caps, growth and gold benefit. Mortgage rates ease a few weeks later.
Gold and miners, emerging markets and big multinationals gain. Importers lose.
Airlines, cruise lines and shippers win. Energy stocks lose. Headline inflation eases.
A growth and small-cap rally is the usual response. Banks lose some margin tailwind.
Bonds rally, defensives (healthcare, staples, utilities) lead. Cyclicals and banks get hit by recession worries.
